state.goal: Research Hetzner fit and current baseline pricing for a modern AI SaaS architecture

found.text:
Hetzner’s official Object Storage overview explains its billing and points to the current pricing page. Hetzner’s traffic page lists included traffic for CX Cloud Servers and Cloud Load Balancers. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/))
Sources:
[s1] Overview - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/

Hetzner’s PostgreSQL documentation describes databases managed through its konsoleH web-hosting interface, not a managed PostgreSQL service with Cloud-specific pricing. I didn’t find an official Hetzner page listing managed PostgreSQL Cloud prices. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/managed/databases/postgresql/))
Sources:
[s2] PostgreSQL - Hetzner Docs — https://docs.hetzner.com/managed/databases/postgresql/

Hetzner Cloud official docs:

Features and API: Servers, networks, firewalls, volumes, load balancers, and related resources are covered in the Cloud API docs. ([docs.hetzner.cloud](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud))

Locations: The locations guide lists data centers and which services are available at each location. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/general/locations/))

Volumes: Block storage can be attached to Cloud Servers; billing is hourly with a monthly price cap. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/volumes/overview/))

Load balancers: The official API docs describe load-balancer types and management. ([docs.hetzner.cloud](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud))

Object Storage: S3-compatible storage is available in Falkenstein, Nuremberg, and Helsinki; the docs explain endpoints and pricing. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/storage/object-storage/overview/))

Pricing: Consult the official Volumes and Object Storage pricing pages for current rates; Cloud resource billing details are also documented in the relevant product guides. ([docs.hetzner.com](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/volumes/overview/))
Sources:
